en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European town taken from fields in the foreground. A tall factory chimney and a large mill or industrial building sit at the left, while above them rise medieval stone fortifications and several prominent towers. Notable are a round defensive tower on the right along the city wall, another large circular tower with a conical roof to the left, and multiple church spires and steeples dominating the skyline. Dense old-town houses cluster around the fortifications. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
